versions.changelog:
**Serenity Framework v2.1.0 — Major Update: Grok summary integration & online data analysis**

- Integrated Grok comprehensive summary of 3,704 tweets to enhance analytical accuracy.
- Added internet connectivity for real-time data verification and OSINT-driven supply chain mapping.
- Expanded output to support analysis of any stock, sector, or industry.
- New research methodology section: built-in Red-team/Blue-team adversarial testing for thesis robustness.
- Updated quantitative position sizing rules, now including detailed margin use best practices.
- New: Sample online analysis report template added (`references/online_analysis_template.md`).
No changes detected in this release.

Major update with expanded framework and deeper analysis:

- Integrated deep analysis of 3,704 Serenity tweets (2025–2026) for framework enhancement.
- Added "Signal Radar v1" rules: Heating, New Entrants, Conviction Watch, Theme Rotation—each with cases.
- Introduced Serenity-style analysis prompt template for consistent, human-like report generation.
- Skill description, tags, and documentation revised to reflect new coverage and methodology.
- Added link to comprehensive deep analysis report; removed legacy skill-card file.

- Added multilingual support with separate English and Chinese names and descriptions.
- Introduced metadata fields: name_zh, description_zh, version, tags, homepage, and agent_created.
- No changes were made to the core framework or analytical methodology.

Serenity Framework Skill 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Analyze any stock using Serenity’s 5-layer supply-chain bottleneck investment framework (macro → bottleneck → company → position → execution).
- Supports both English and Chinese users.
- Generates structured analysis reports with macro demand, supply chain bottleneck map, company screening, position sizing, and risk factors.
- Triggered by user requests related to investment thesis, position sizing, stop-thesis, or supply chain bottleneck analysis.
- Includes example case study and detailed stop-thesis risk management rules.
